title: Make every step something you actually do
statement: As a developer, I can see that each step either proves something is true or changes the state of the world, so a checked box means a specific thing happened.
overview: The tool cannot judge whether a step is truly actionable, so that remains with the author and whoever reviews the change. A proof step: "The Release workflow for this tag succeeded". A change step: "Turn on enforcement in repository settings".

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every step is either a proof or a change; adding one without saying which is refused, in the template and on a release.
The reader and `release list --steps` show each step's kind.
`release guide` tells the author to write each step as one specific action someone can do, and gives an example of each kind.
